---
title: "MINDSET2 Carbon Price scenario"
subtitle: "IPCC regions; up to 2050; results: `r params$results_dir`; baseline: `r params$baseline_dir`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B, %Y %H:%M')`"
output:
  beamer_presentation:
    theme: "Antibes"
    colortheme: "dolphin"
    fig_width: 8
    fig_height: 4.5
    fig_caption: true
header-includes:
  - \usepackage[sfdefault,condensed]{roboto}
  - \usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
  - \AtBeginSection{}
  - \AtBeginSubsection{}
# Usage: set the params below (folders relative to Results/) and press Knit; scenario_figures_<scenario>.pdf
# (or _all.pdf when several scenarios are plotted) is written into results_dir.
# Console: rmarkdown::render("scenario_figures.Rmd", params = list(results_dir = ".", baseline_dir = ".", scenario = "cprice_disagg"),
#            output_dir = ".", output_file = "scenario_figures_cprice_disagg.pdf")
params:
  results_dir: "."    # change here! 
  # scenario results folder, relative to Results/ ("." = current, or e.g. archive_scenario_cprice_disagg_YYYYMMDD_HHMM); the PDF is written there
  baseline_dir: "."   # change here! 
  # baseline results folder to compare against, relative to Results/
  scenario: ""        # one scenario name, or "" for every scenario in results_dir
knit: (function(input, ...) {
    p <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(input)$params;
    d <- file.path(dirname(input), p$results_dir);
    s <- setdiff(sub("^results_file_long_(.+)_0[.]csv$", "\\1", list.files(d, "^results_file_long_.+_0[.]csv$")), "empty");
    nm <- if (nzchar(p$scenario)) p$scenario else if (length(s) == 1) s else "all";
    rmarkdown::render(input, output_dir = d, output_file = paste0("scenario_figures_", nm, ".pdf"), envir = globalenv()) })
---



```{r Load packages,include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(ggthemes)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(plotly)
library(tinytex)

sysfonts::font_add_google(name = "Roboto Condensed")
showtext::showtext_auto()

# Fuel sectors identified by name (sheet P), so the energy figures work for GLORIA-120 and any aggregation.
# GLORIA-120: Coal 24, 25, 62; Petrol 26, 63; Gas 27, 94; Electricity 93; primary fuels 24-27.
sector_names <- readxl::read_excel(file.path("..", "Data", "MSET_data", "Variable_list_MINDSET.xlsx"), sheet = "P")
fuel_lookup <- sector_names %>%
  transmute(code = Lfd_Nr,
            fuel = case_when(
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("hard coal|lignite|coke oven", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Coal",
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("petroleum extraction|refined petroleum", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Petrol",
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("gas extraction|gaseous fuels", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Gas",
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("electric power", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Electricity"),
            primary = str_detect(Sector_names, regex("hard coal|lignite|petroleum extraction|gas extraction", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fuel))
fuel_of <- setNames(fuel_lookup$fuel, fuel_lookup$code)
primary_fuel_sectors <- fuel_lookup$code[fuel_lookup$primary]

# Results to plot (folders relative to Results/; set in params at the top)
baseline_name <- "empty"
scen_of <- function(f) {   # scenario of a results file: numbered summary file or per-year energy flows
  b <- basename(f)
  s <- ifelse(grepl("_energy_flows(_fd)?_\\d{4}\\.parquet$", b),
              sub("^results_file_long_(.+)_energy_flows(_fd)?_\\d{4}\\.parquet$", "\\1", b),
              sub("^results_file_long_(.+)_\\d+\\.(csv|parquet)$", "\\1", b))
  ifelse(s == b, NA_character_, s)
}
scenarios_in <- function(dir) unique(na.omit(scen_of(list.files(dir, "^results_file_long_.+_0\\.csv$"))))
rfiles <- function(pattern) {   # baseline files from params$baseline_dir + scenario files from params$results_dir
  fb <- list.files(params$baseline_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  fb <- fb[scen_of(fb) %in% baseline_name]
  wanted <- if (nzchar(params$scenario)) params$scenario else setdiff(scenarios_in(params$results_dir), baseline_name)
  fs <- list.files(params$results_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  fs <- fs[scen_of(fs) %in% wanted]
  c(fb, fs)
}
# Two header rows for a table pivoted with names_from = c('year', <scenario or variable>) (columns "<year>_<x>"),
# built from the table's own columns so any number of scenarios works: the lower row labels each column, the upper
# row groups adjacent columns (years over scenarios, or scenarios over years, whichever the column order gives).
pivot_header <- function(k, tab, n_id = 1, id_labels = rep(" ", n_id)) {
  cols  <- names(tab)[-seq_len(n_id)]
  yr    <- sub("_.*$", "", cols)
  other <- sub("_$", "", sub("^[^_]*_", "", cols))    # "cprice_disagg_" -> "cprice_disagg"
  if (all(rle(yr)$lengths == 1)) { lower <- yr; up <- rle(other) } else { lower <- other; up <- rle(yr) }
  k %>%
    add_header_above(c(setNames(rep(1, n_id), id_labels), setNames(rep(1, length(lower)), lower))) %>%
    add_header_above(c(setNames(n_id, " "), setNames(up$lengths, up$values)))
}
# Detailed split used by some figures: hard coal (incl. coke oven products) separate from lignite.
fuel_detail_of <- setNames(case_when(
  str_detect(sector_names$Sector_names, regex("hard coal|coke oven", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Hard coal",
  str_detect(sector_names$Sector_names, regex("lignite", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Lignite",
  str_detect(sector_names$Sector_names, regex("petroleum extraction|refined petroleum", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Petrol",
  str_detect(sector_names$Sector_names, regex("gas extraction|gaseous fuels", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Gas",
  str_detect(sector_names$Sector_names, regex("electric power", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Electricity"),
  sector_names$Lfd_Nr)
fuel_detail_of <- fuel_detail_of[!is.na(fuel_detail_of)]
```

```{r Load data#2 - 2D vars,include=FALSE}
# read_and_prefix <- function(filename) {
#   res <- read_parquet(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
#     mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=results\\_file\\_long\\_)[a-z_]{1,}")) %>% 
#     filter(!is.na(energy_flows)) %>% filter(year > 2025 & REG_imp == 'SAS') %>% filter(energy_flows > 0)
#   return(res)
# }

read_and_prefix <- function(filename) {
  res <- read_csv(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=results\\_file\\_long\\_)[a-z_]{1,}"))
  return(res)
}

combined_data <- files %>%
  map(read_and_prefix) %>%
  list_rbind()

combined_data <- gather(combined_data, "var_name", "value", -REG_imp,-PROD_COMM,-year,-scenario)

unique(combined_data$scenario)
unique(combined_data$var_name)
unique(combined_data$REG_imp)

```

## 1.1 Economic output
### Economic output - all regions, figure
\framesubtitle{bn USD, constant 2019 price}

```{r Print 1.1a figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>% 
  filter(var_name == 'normal_output' & year > 2018) %>%
  # filter(REG_imp != 'EAS') %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, year, scenario) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = value / 10**6) %>% 
  ungroup()

base <- df %>% filter(scenario == 'empty_') %>% select(-scenario) %>% rename(base_value = value)

set_colors <- brewer.pal(n = length(unique(df$REG_imp)), name = "Paired")
names(set_colors) <- unique(df$REG_imp)

g <- df %>%
  left_join(base) %>% 
  filter(scenario != 'empty_') %>%
  mutate(value = value / base_value - 1) %>% 
  mutate(value = value * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp)) + 
  geom_line()  + 
  theme_few() + 
  labs(y='economic output (% difference from baseline)', color='region') + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) + 
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors) + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Roboto Condensed")) + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario)

g

# ggplotly(g)
```

### Economic output - all regions, table
\framesubtitle{bn USD, constant 2019 price}

```{r Print 1.1a table,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>% 
  filter(var_name == 'output' & year > 2018) %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, year, scenario) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = value / 10**6) %>% 
  ungroup()

base <- df %>% filter(scenario == 'empty_') %>% select(-scenario) %>% rename(base_value = value)

df <- df %>% 
  left_join(base) %>% 
  mutate(value = value / base_value -1 ) %>% 
  filter(scenario != 'empty_')

df1 <- df %>%
  mutate(value = round(value, digits=2)) %>%
  mutate(value = scales::percent(value)) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c(2019,2025,2030,2040,2050)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols='REG_imp', names_from=c('year','scenario'), values_from='value')

df1 %>%
  rename(Region = REG_imp) %>%
  kbl(booktabs=TRUE, col.names = NULL) %>%
      # digits = 0, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) %>%
  pivot_header(df1) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down","HOLD_position"))
```

## 1.4 Prices
### Output deflator (output-weighted), figure
\framesubtitle{index, 2019 = 100}

```{r Print 1.4a figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}

df <- combined_data %>%
  filter(var_name %in% c('dp_all','output') & year > 2018) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c('REG_imp','PROD_COMM','year','scenario'), names_from='var_name', values_from='value') %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, year, scenario) %>%
  mutate(dp_all = dp_all * output / sum(output)) %>%
  summarise(dp_all = sum(dp_all)) %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, scenario) %>%
  mutate(price_index = cumprod(dp_all + 1) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

base <- df %>% filter(scenario == 'empty_') %>% select(REG_imp, year, base_index = price_index)

g <- df %>%
  left_join(base) %>%
  filter(scenario != 'empty_') %>%
  mutate(value = price_index / base_index - 1) %>%
  mutate(value = value * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_few() +
  labs(y='price level (% difference from baseline)', color='region') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors) + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario)

g
# ggplotly(g)
```

### Wages, figure

```{r Print 1.4b figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}

df <- combined_data %>%
  filter(var_name %in% c('wage','employment_base') & year > 2018) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c('REG_imp','PROD_COMM','year','scenario'), names_from='var_name', values_from='value') %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, year, scenario) %>%
  mutate(wage = wage * employment_base / sum(employment_base)) %>%
  summarise(wage = sum(wage)) %>%
  ungroup()

base <- df %>% filter(scenario == 'empty_') %>% select(REG_imp, year, base_wage = wage)

g <- df %>%
  left_join(base) %>%
  filter(scenario != 'empty_') %>%
  mutate(value = wage / base_wage - 1) %>%
  mutate(value = value * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_few() +
  labs(y='wages (% difference from baseline)', color='region') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors) + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario)

g
```

# 4D variables

```{r Load data#1 - 4D vars,include=FALSE}
# parquet — load all scenarios
files = rfiles("results_file_long.*energy_flows_[0-9]{4}.parquet")
head(open_dataset(files[1]),5)
```


```{r Load data#2 - 4D vars,include=FALSE}
read_and_prefix <- function(filename) {
  res <- read_parquet(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=_long_).+(?=_energy_flows_\\d{4})")) %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(str_extract(basename(filename), "[0-9]{4}"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fuel_use)) %>% filter(year > 2018) %>% filter(fuel_use > 0)
  return(res)
}

combined_data <- files %>%
  map(read_and_prefix) %>%
  list_rbind()

combined_data <- gather(combined_data, "var_name", "value", -REG_imp,-REG_exp,-PROD_COMM,-TRAD_COMM,-year,-scenario)

unique(combined_data$scenario)
unique(combined_data$var_name)
unique(combined_data$REG_imp)
unique(combined_data$year)

```

## 2.3 Energy intensity of output

```{r Load additional data - 4D vars,include=FALSE}
files = rfiles("results_file_long.*0.csv")

read_and_prefix <- function(filename) {
  res <- read_csv(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=_long_).+(?=_\\d+\\.\\w+)"))
  return(res)
}

combined_data2 <- files %>%
  map(read_and_prefix) %>%
  list_rbind()

combined_data2 <- gather(combined_data2, "var_name", "value", -REG_imp,-PROD_COMM,-year,-scenario)
combined_data2
```



### Energy intensity of output, figure
\framesubtitle{TJ per mn USD constant price (2019 base) economic output}

```{r Print 2.3a figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df_energy <- combined_data %>%
  filter(var_name == 'fuel_use' & year > 2018) %>%
  group_by(scenario, year, REG_imp) %>%
  summarise(energy = sum(value)) %>% ungroup()

df_output <- combined_data2 %>%
  filter(var_name == 'output' & year > 2018) %>%
  group_by(scenario, year, REG_imp) %>%
  summarise(output = sum(value) / 10**3) %>% ungroup()

df <- df_energy %>%
  left_join(df_output) %>%
  mutate(intensity = energy / output)

base <- df %>% filter(scenario == 'empty') %>% select(REG_imp, year, base_intensity = intensity)

g <- df %>%
  left_join(base) %>%
  filter(scenario != 'empty') %>%
  mutate(value = intensity / base_intensity - 1) %>%
  mutate(value = value * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_few() +
  labs(y='energy intensity (% difference from baseline)', color='region') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors) + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario)

g
```

```{r Print 2.3b figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
g <- df %>%
  left_join(base) %>%
  filter(scenario != 'empty') %>%
  mutate(value = intensity / base_intensity - 1) %>%
  mutate(value = value * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_few() +
  labs(y='fossil energy intensity (% difference from baseline)', color='region') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors) + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario)

g
```

# 1D variables

```{r, include=FALSE}
files = rfiles("results_file_long.*2.csv")

names(read_csv(files[1]))

read_and_prefix <- function(filename) {
  res <- read_csv(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=results\\_file\\_long\\_)[a-z_]{1,}"))
  return(res)
}

combined_data <- files %>%
  map(read_and_prefix) %>%
  list_rbind()

combined_data <- gather(combined_data, "var_name", "value", -REG_imp,-year,-scenario)

unique(combined_data$scenario)
unique(combined_data$var_name)
unique(combined_data$REG_imp)

```


## 3.1 Unemployment
### Unemployment & shadow unemployment rate, figure
\framesubtitle{rate, employment divided by labour force}

```{r Print 3.1a figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>%
  filter(year > 2018 & var_name %in% c('unemployment_rate','shadow_unemployment_rate'))

base <- df %>% filter(scenario == 'empty_') %>% select(-scenario) %>% rename(base_value = value)

g <- df %>%
  left_join(base) %>%
  filter(scenario != 'empty_') %>%
  # mutate(value = value / base_value - 1) %>%
  mutate(value = value * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp, linetype=var_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_few() +
  labs(y='unemployment rate (% difference from baseline)', color='region', linetype='variable') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors) + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario)

g
```


### Unemployment & shadow unemployment rate, table
\framesubtitle{rate, employment divided by labour force}

```{r Print 3.1b table,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>%
  filter(year > 2018 & var_name %in% c('unemployment_rate','shadow_unemployment_rate'))

base <- df %>% filter(scenario == 'empty_') %>% select(-scenario) %>% rename(base_value = value)

df1 <- df %>%
  left_join(base) %>%
  filter(scenario != 'empty_') %>%
  # mutate(value = value / base_value - 1) %>%
  mutate(value = round(value, digits=2)) %>%
  mutate(value = scales::percent(value)) %>%
    filter(year %in% c(2019,2025,2030,2040,2050)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c('REG_imp','scenario'), names_from=c('year','var_name'), values_from='value')

df1 %>%
  rename(Region = REG_imp) %>%
  kbl(booktabs=TRUE, col.names = NULL) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, " "=1, "2019"=1,"2025" = 1, "2030" = 1, "2040" = 1, "2050"=1, "2019"=1,"2025" = 1, "2030" = 1, "2040" = 1,"2050"=1)) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Shadow unemployment rate (%)" = 5, "Unemployment rate (%)" = 5)) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down","HOLD_position"))
```
